title: How to use My Home
summary: Read your day, track time, review task totals, and build a Focus list.

blocks.heading: My Home at a glance
paragraphs: My Home is your daily starting point. It combines time tracking, task totals, SOPs, and the tasks you have chosen to focus on.
Use the summary at the top to decide what needs attention, then work from the Focus list below.

blocks.caption: The live My Home workspace
blocks.alt: The current My Home workspace showing the greeting, time tracker, task totals, SOP count, and Focus list

blocks.heading: Greeting and time tracker
paragraphs: The top of My Home shows the current day, week, and quarter. The time tracker shows how much of your work target is complete and whether tracking is active.
Choose Work, Break, or No work to start the matching timer. The status and progress update in the same card.

blocks.heading: Task summary
paragraphs: The summary cards group your workload into New tasks, Today, Overdue, Tomorrow, and All tasks. Select a card to open the matching task view.
The SOPs badge shows how many assigned SOP items need attention.

blocks.heading: Focus list
paragraphs: Star a task to add it to the Focus list. This creates a short working list without changing the task itself.
Use Group to organize starred tasks, and use the calendar button to switch the Focus list to a date-based view.
